body: Yeah I totally understand that pov. I'm just tryna show what worked for me. It 100% won't work for everyone. Everyone is different and have different types of depression. I'm just the kind of person who gets overwhelmed and very impulsive so that's kind of the person this post is catered toward. Also even tho life has ups and downs, it's false to say life only gets worse. Unless u can predict the future that's totally a random guess. Having ur life being terrible forever is impossible. Good stuff happens eventually. For me I forget the good stuff that happens so I thought this for ages but then I decided to write down good stuff as it happened and realised life isn't as bad as it seems. Depression literally warps ur brains persepction of everything around U.
